entities.summary: Peter C. B. Phillips (b. 1948-03-23, Weymouth) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Weymouth and New Zealand. Known in the fields of new zealand, merchants & economists, oceania.
